parole.significato: The Japanese variation of the Korean dish kimchi, usually having a milder flavor.
parole.testo: From Japanese キムチ (kimuchi), from Korean 김치 (gimchi). Doublet of kimchi.

parole.significato: Of a Japanese font or typeface, being in the Mincho style.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Japanese 明(みん)朝(ちょう) (Minchō, literally “Ming Dynasty”). Doublet of Myeongjo, borrowed from Korean.

parole.significato: Foodstuff that has undergone retort sterilization.
parole.testo: Calque of Japanese レトルト食品 (retoruto shokuhin), or calque of Korean 레토르트 식품(食品) (retoreuteu sikpum).
